name: search_companies
label: Search companies
description: Searches Norwegian companies by name, NACE industry, municipality, or any combination. Returns iterable bundles — each match is one bundle you can use directly in the next module.

parameters.help: Company name prefix (e.g. 'equinor') or an exact nine-digit organization number. Leave empty if you only filter by NACE code or municipality. Use 'Get company' when you already know the organization number and want its full basic record.
parameters.name: q
parameters.label: Company name or organization number

parameters.help: Industry code (SN2007). E.g. 06.100 (Extraction of crude petroleum), 62.010 (Computer programming). Uses prefix matching — '06' matches all 06.xxx codes.
parameters.name: nace
parameters.label: NACE code

parameters.help: Four-digit municipality number from SSB (Statistics Norway). E.g. 0301 = Oslo, 1103 = Stavanger, 5001 = Trondheim.
parameters.name: kommune
parameters.label: Municipality number

parameters.help: Number of companies to return (1–100). Default 10. Make stops iterating when this is reached.
parameters.name: limit
parameters.label: Max number of results

parameters.help: Optional API page size (1–100). Leave empty to use Max number of results. A smaller value lets Make retrieve several pages, for example 2 per page and 5 results total.
parameters.name: page_size
parameters.label: API page size
